mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month average compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profits through wage growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >1% month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.1 percentage points compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month average signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO declines and PAYEMS growth falls below 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% year-over-year), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and HOUST falls > 1.0% month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
